_readme: Condition tier seed (epic E4, FR-8..FR-11): the human-reviewed verdict
for which conditions the buff engine (E8) computes and which are
tracked manually. Checked in, PR-reviewed by the owners; the importer
never derives math from pack documents (Constitution Article IV).
A condition with NO entry here defaults to display-only (fail-safe)
and is listed in every import run report under `unmapped conditions`.
Extend this file by PR to move a condition into the engine tier.
Entry shape:
upstream_id   the Foundry pack document _id (stable across releases)
name          display name, for human readers of this file
tier          "engine_math" (with mappings) or "display_only" (without)
valued        optional expectation that the condition carries a value;
a mismatch with the upstream document warns in the run report
modifiers     engine-math only: [{modifier_type, stat, value_kind, value?, polarity?}]
modifier_type  circumstance | status | item | untyped
stat           closed vocabulary: ac, fort, ref, will, perception, speed,
attack, damage, spell_attack, spell_dc, class_dc,
all_checks, all_dcs, all_checks_and_dcs, skill:<name>
value_kind     "constant" (value: integer, negative = penalty)
or "condition_value" (one parameterized mapping serves
every value of the condition — frightened 1..4 share it)
polarity       condition_value ONLY: "positive" or "negative" — the
sign applied to the condition's value; stored data, never
derived (frightened is "negative": a status PENALTY).
constant mappings must not carry it (value is signed).
note          optional human note

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.note: Player Core: 'You take a status penalty equal to this value to all your checks and DCs.' Verified against the captured pack document. The penalty sign is the stored polarity — frightened 1 resolves to −1, frightened 2 to −2, never a bonus.

conditions.name: Concealed
conditions.note: The DC 5 flat check to target a concealed creature is not expressible in the closed stat vocabulary — the importer must not fabricate it. Tracked manually.
